positions.title: Senior Quantum Error Correction Software Engineer
Quantum Error Correction Engineer
positions.description: Explored the implementation of quantum error correcting primitives with current hardware, as well as developing models for hardware requirements for quantum memories. Developed hardware-conscious error models for surface code simulations using novel gate schemes. Implemented error models in resource estimation, completing a pipeline from device simulations of existing hardware to resource requirements for logical algorithms.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Continued research on techniques for improving state stabilization and passive error correction. Explored guidelines in simulation for error-divisible two-qubit gates for superconducting architectures. Collaborated on an implementation and applications of a novel iteration of the Variational Quantum Eigensolver.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Continued research in passive error correction with the VSLQ device. Expanded exploration of qubit coupling techniques for improving device lifetimes for small logical qubits using numerical optimization techniques for coupling strength pulse shaping and variable dissipation abstractions.

positions.title: Graduate Research Intern
positions.description: Began participating on the Very Small Logical Qubit project by reproducing a simulation of the device Hamiltonian by evolving it under the Lindblad master equation for dissipative systems and extracting the logical qubit lifetime using the QuTiP library in Python. The internship also involved attending weekly research presentations by invited speakers covering a range of topics in computational materials science.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for teaching two sections of introductory physics lab I and II. This consisted of proctoring weekly two hour labs and grading weekly lab reports for each sessions. Additional responsibilities included setting up lab equipment prior to each session and make available time outside of class for students seeking help.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked in developing density graphs based on slater determinants for a visualization of molecular electronic structure. This involved writing a Fortran subroutine to interface with the General Atomic and Molecular Electronic Structure Systems (GAMESS) software stack. This project provides computational chemists with a visualization tool for complex wavefunctions that could provide insights and guidance into properly and efficiently truncating small-contribution molecular orbitals for computationally expensive molecular electronic structure simulations.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for overseeing and assisting in introductory physics I and II lab courses, in addition to grading lab reports and answering student questions outside of lab.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Participated in a study to determine the primordial helium abundance using data from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey. This work involved using IRAF (Image Reduction and Analysis Facility) to analyse emission spectra from blue compact dwarf galaxies, and writing our own Fortran subroutine to generate sets of likelihood parameters output by a Markov Chain Monte Carlo to make a determination of their helium abundance . These results were compared to predictions from the Cosmic Microwave Background.
